boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented Caltech activities that are free to attend or watch, spanning public science programs, films, astronomy, mathematics, and author conversations.

cards.title: Catch a Watson Lecture
cards.subtitle: Free public science talks at Beckman Auditorium
cards.notes: Arrive before the talk to explore the interactive displays, then stay afterward for the audience question-and-answer session.
cards.short_summary: Hear Caltech researchers explain current discoveries in an approachable public program.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech states that the Earnest C. Watson Lecture Series is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; consult the series page for the current schedule and any registration instructions.

cards.title: Look Through Caltech’s Telescopes
cards.subtitle: A free public lecture followed by guided stargazing
cards.notes: Check the outreach calendar, bring a friend, and remain after the monthly lecture for telescope viewing with astronomy guides.
cards.short_summary: Pair an astronomy talk with a guided look at the night sky through telescopes.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech identifies its monthly Stargazing Lectures and guided telescope viewing as frequent, free public outreach events.
cards.access_notes: Free public outreach; dates and locations vary, so confirm the current listing before attending.

cards.title: Join a Sidewalk Astronomy Session
cards.subtitle: Free telescope viewing with Caltech Astro
cards.notes: Watch Caltech Astro’s event listings, meet at the announced viewing site, and take turns observing with the provided telescopes.
cards.short_summary: Gather around telescopes for an informal, no-admission astronomy outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech lists sidewalk astronomy among Caltech Astro’s frequent, free public outreach events.
cards.access_notes: Free and public when scheduled; the venue changes by event, and attendance details should be checked in advance.

cards.title: Spend the Day at Explore Caltech
cards.subtitle: An annual free public science-and-engineering event
cards.notes: Plan a group visit when the annual date is announced and rotate through hands-on activities presented by Caltech researchers.
cards.short_summary: Explore multiple fields of campus research through family-friendly demonstrations and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech describes Explore Caltech as a free public annual event featuring science and engineering activities.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public when offered annually; verify the announced date and registration details.

cards.title: Play Through the AIM Math Fair
cards.subtitle: Free games and puzzles beside Caltech Hall Pond
cards.notes: RSVP if requested, gather by Caltech Hall Pond, and work through the all-ages puzzle and mathematics stations together.
cards.short_summary: Turn collaborative puzzles, games, and mathematical challenges into a social afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s 2026 AIM 32nd Birthday Celebration Fair page states that the event is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The June 27, 2026 event was free and public with an RSVP link; check for the next annual fair before making plans.

cards.title: Join a Behind the Book Conversation
cards.subtitle: Free Caltech author talks with audience questions
cards.notes: Choose an online or campus conversation, read the speaker description beforehand, and bring a question for the closing Q&A.
cards.short_summary: Discuss how authors connect personal histories with arts, science, and society.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech places Behind the Book among its free online and in-person public event series and says each conversation includes audience Q&A.
cards.access_notes: Free series with online and in-person offerings; use the event listing to confirm format and registration.

cards.title: Tune In to a Science Exchange Conversation
cards.subtitle: Primarily online discussions with Caltech researchers
cards.notes: Pick a topic your group wants to unpack, join the announced stream together, and compare takeaways after the conversation.
cards.short_summary: Use a researcher-led discussion as a launch point for a low-key science hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech lists Science Exchange Conversations among its free public series and describes them as primarily online researcher conversations.
cards.access_notes: Free and primarily online; check the individual program page for the live link, date, and registration requirements.

cards.title: Meet Up for Movies That Matter
cards.subtitle: A free Caltech film series focused on science and social justice
cards.notes: Review the current film listing, invite friends interested in its theme, and leave time afterward to talk through the issues raised.
cards.short_summary: Watch a curated film and continue the evening with a thoughtful group discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech lists Movies That Matter among its free event series and says its films address science and social-justice issues.
cards.access_notes: Free series; screening dates, formats, audience access, and any registration are provided on individual listings.

cards.title: Stream a von Kármán Lecture Together
cards.subtitle: Archived JPL mission talks available through Caltech’s series page
cards.notes: Choose a mission from the linked archive, set up a group screening, and pause afterward to compare questions and favorite details.
cards.short_summary: Make a shared watch session from JPL’s archived mission and exploration lectures.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech’s free-series page links to a YouTube playlist of past Theodore von Kármán Lectures after noting that the series ended in 2024.
cards.access_notes: The archived lecture playlist is available online without admission; internet access and a viewing device are needed.

cards.title: Reserve a Free JPL Tour
cards.subtitle: A limited public visit to the Caltech-managed laboratory
cards.notes: Watch for a reservation opening, book the group together, and review JPL’s identification and security requirements before arrival.
cards.short_summary: See the JPL visitor center and learn about spacecraft missions during a reserved visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Caltech states that JPL offers a limited number of free tours for public and educational groups by reservation.
cards.access_notes: Free but reservation-only and capacity-limited; follow the linked JPL tour rules, identification requirements, and availability.
